export_pytorch_model_to_onnx: export a PyTorch model to ONNX format with configurable opset version and dynamic axes
export_model_to_pretty_string: export a PyTorch model to a human-readable ONNX text representation for debugging
check_unconvertible_ops: check which operators in a PyTorch model are not yet supported by the ONNX exporter
register_custom_op_symbolic: register a custom ONNX symbolic function for a user-defined operator at a given opset version
get_model_signature: get the inspect.Signature of a PyTorch model's forward method for input inspection
